relations.justification: Physics is stated in mathematics; the calculus of change is a precondition for mechanics, not an application of it.
Theoretical computer science is a branch of discrete mathematics and cannot be approached without it.
Econometrics is applied probability and linear algebra.
Bioinformatics is algorithm design over biological sequence data.
Cryptography is number theory and algebra put to an adversarial purpose.
Practical cryptography exemplifies the gap between information-theoretic and computational secrecy.
Artificial neural networks were named for and loosely modelled on neural architecture; the analogy is real at the level of weighted summation and useless below it.
Mathematical logic supplies proof, set and quantifier notation that formal mathematics is written in.
Computational logic is logic constrained by what a machine can decide.

Shannon entropy and thermodynamic entropy are the same functional form over a probability distribution; Shannon adopted the name on that basis and the identification is exact up to Boltzmann's constant.
Entropy defines the compression limit — the source coding theorem is the statement that the bound is exactly the entropy.
Relative entropy and mutual information are two readings of one quantity — mutual information is the divergence between joint and product distributions.
Source coding bounds are stated in entropy; compression cannot be motivated before the measure exists.
Channel capacity is a mutual-information maximisation and presupposes the information measures.
Compression and prediction are the same problem: a model that predicts well codes short, and minimum description length makes the identity explicit.
Rate-distortion is stated as a minimisation of mutual information subject to a distortion constraint; the measure is constitutive of the statement.
Universal coding superseded fixed-model coding in general-purpose use by removing the requirement to know the source distribution in advance.
Channel capacity and transport limits are both maximum-throughput results derived from a statistical description of a noisy medium.
Algorithmic information refutes the sufficiency of the probabilistic account for single objects: entropy is undefined for one string, Kolmogorov complexity is not.
Algorithmic randomness and thermodynamic disorder both identify the incompressible with the typical — a microstate needing full description is one of the overwhelming majority.
Fourier decomposition is the shared mathematics of signal analysis and wave physics; the transform is one object used under two names.
Time and frequency representations are a transform pair — information present in one is fully recoverable from the other, and the sampling theorem is the bridge.
Vector representation generalises the embedding step every modern learning system performs.
A feedback loop is defined over a system boundary; the boundary must be drawn before the loop can be traced.
Negative feedback regulation and physiological homeostasis are one mechanism described in two vocabularies — setpoint, error signal, effector.
Positive feedback destabilises: a self-reinforcing loop moves a system away from equilibrium until a limit intervenes.
Delay between action and effect converts a stabilising loop into an oscillating one — the classic cause of overshoot in regulated systems.
Control theory generalises the feedback loops a robot implements; robotics is one instantiation.
Deterministic chaos was discovered in atmospheric modelling; weather is the canonical system where sensitivity to initial conditions bounds prediction.
Adaptation in complex systems and biological evolution are the same selection-variation-retention loop; evolutionary theory is the worked case.
Power-law behaviour in complex systems and heavy-tailed return distributions in finance share the scale-invariance that makes extreme events far more likely than a normal model predicts.
Network diffusion and epidemic transmission use the same compartmental mathematics; the basic reproduction number is a threshold on the contact graph.
Requisite variety and channel capacity are both statements that a regulator or channel must match the variety it must absorb.
Cybernetics and information theory developed in the same post-war moment and share the concept of a signal carrying control.
